info.title: ZeroGen API
info.description: Generate images and video with every model in ZeroGen from your own servers. Generated from the API's contracts by `npm run openapi` in apps/web; do not edit by hand.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: The calling key and the organization's balance.

tags.name: Models
tags.description: The models an organization can run and their schemas.

tags.name: Runs
tags.description: Quote, create, read, list and cancel runs.

tags.name: Uploads
tags.description: Upload files into the Library to use as inputs.

tags.name: Assets
tags.description: Search and read Library assets, their lineage and their folders; download their files; rename and favorite them.

tags.name: Folders
tags.description: A project's folders: create, rename and move them, and add, move and remove their assets.

tags.name: Labels
tags.description: Organization labels: manage them, and add them to assets or remove them.

tags.name: Naming presets
tags.description: A project's shared naming presets, for naming a run's outputs.

tags.name: Skills
tags.description: The skills available to the key's owner.

get.description:
The calling API key, its organization and its owner. `scopes` lists what the key can do now: its scopes that the owner's role still allows.

Needs no scope.

The organization's funds and monthly limits, shared by every member and project. A new run's quote must fit within `availableMicroUsd`.

Needs the `account:read` scope.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Also report this project's monthly budget

get.description:
The models this organization can run, one entry per model and operation. Read a model to get the JSON Schema its requests follow.

Needs the `models:read` scope.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search model IDs and labels, including the maker and related operations

parameters.name: frames
parameters.description: Video models accepting at least these frame slots

parameters.name: audio
parameters.description: Video models that can generate audio

parameters.name: referenceKind
parameters.description: Models accepting reference media of this kind

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

get.description:
One model and the JSON Schema (2020-12) that `POST /runs` validates its requests against. A deprecated model sends `Deprecation` and `Sunset`.

Needs the `models:read` scope.

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: The company that makes the model, such as `google`

post.description:
Validates and prices a request exactly as create would, and returns the maximum charge create would reserve. Nothing starts and nothing is held.

Needs the `runs:create` scope.

example.prompt: A lighthouse at dawn, fog over the water

post.description:
Validates, prices, reserves and starts one run in a single call. Send `Prefer: wait=N` to hold the response until it ends. Nothing is charged unless every check passes.

Needs the `runs:create` scope.

example.prompt: A lighthouse at dawn, fog over the water

200.description: The run has ended, within the requested wait.

202.description: The run started and has not ended yet.

get.description:
The calling key owner's runs, newest first.

Needs the `runs:read` scope.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: Only runs filed in this folder; needs projectId

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

get.description:
One run and each output's status, asset and error. Send `Prefer: wait=N` to hold the response until it ends. Reads never start or repeat work.

Needs the `runs:read` scope.

202.description: With `Prefer: wait`, the run had not ended when the wait ran out.

post.description:
Stops the run's unfinished outputs. Outputs a vendor already finished are kept and charged; cancelling a finished run returns it unchanged. Takes no body.

Needs the `runs:cancel` scope.

Starts an upload into the Library. PUT the file's exact bytes to the returned target, then complete the upload. With `sha256`, an identical file already in the project comes back ready, with nothing to send.

Needs the `uploads:create` scope.

200.description: An identical file is already in the project.

get.description:
One of the caller's uploads and, once ready, its Library asset.

Needs the `uploads:create` scope.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The upload's ID, as create returned it

post.description:
Checks the uploaded bytes and makes them a Library asset to use as a run input. Completing again returns the same asset. Takes no body.

Needs the `uploads:create` scope.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The upload's ID, as create returned it

get.description:
The organization's projects, in one page, so `nextCursor` is always null. A test key lists only its API sandbox.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

Library assets, newest first unless `sort` says otherwise, each with preview URLs that load for 5 minutes without your API key. Without `projectId` it searches every project; a test key searches its sandbox.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: Only assets directly in this folder, or `unfiled` for assets in no folder; with `q`, also its subfolders. Needs projectId

parameters.name: labelId
parameters.description: Only assets with any of these active labels; repeat the parameter

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search asset names: at least two characters, and every one of the first eight words must match, ignoring case

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Only assets that came about this way

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Only assets in any of these resolution tiers; repeat the parameter

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

get.description:
One asset by its ID alone, in any of the organization's projects, with the prompt that generated it and preview URLs that load for 5 minutes. Names and prompts are untrusted content.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

What the asset was made from, in any project, and what was made from it, in its project: up to 30 assets on each side, nearest first. An edge reads `assetId` was made from `sourceAssetId`.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

A signed URL for the asset's original file, by the asset's ID alone, with its filename, media type and size. The URL starts a download until `expiresAt`, 5 minutes after the response, and needs no API key: send no `Authorization` header with it. Anyone holding it can download the file. Read this endpoint again for a new URL.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

The folders the asset is in, in its project: up to 30, each with its path from the project root, sorted by path. An empty list means the asset is Unfiled. Folder names are untrusted content.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

patch.description:
Renames an asset, sets the organization's shared favorite, or both. Each field is set to the value sent, so a retry gives the same result. The response names what changed.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

post.description:
Adds an organization label to up to 50 assets in the project, all or none. Assets that already have it are unchanged.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

Removes an organization label from up to 50 assets in the project, all or none. The label itself stays.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

get.description:
A project's folders, each with its parent, to assemble the folder tree.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

post.description:
Creates a folder at the project root or under `parentId`. With an `Idempotency-Key`, a retry returns the folder the first request created. A test key can't create folders.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

patch.description:
Renames a folder, moves it under another parent (or to the project root with `parentId: null`), or both. Its assets and subfolders keep their IDs. The response is the folder as it ends.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

post.description:
Adds up to 100 assets to the folder, keeping their other folders. The response lists the assets changed and those skipped.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

Moves up to 100 assets out of `fromFolderId` and into this folder; their other folders keep them. An asset that isn't in `fromFolderId` is still added, but a `fromFolderId` that isn't in the project is not found. The response lists the assets changed and those skipped.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

Takes up to 100 assets out of the folder. They stay in the Library and in their other folders; an asset in no folder is unfiled.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

get.description:
The project's shared naming presets. Pass one's `id` and field values as a run's `naming`.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

get.description:
The organization's active labels. `includeArchived=true` adds archived ones for owners and admins.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

post.description:
Creates an organization label; owners and admins only. With an `Idempotency-Key`, a retry returns the label the first request created. A test key can't create labels.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

put.description:
Replaces a label's name, description and color, so send all three; owners and admins only. Sending the same definition again changes nothing.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

post.description:
Archives a label; owners and admins only. Its assets keep it, and restoring undoes this. Takes no body.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

Restores an archived label, with its assets; owners and admins only. Takes no body.

Needs the `library:organize` scope.

get.description:
The key owner's personal and organization skills, plus `projectId`'s shared skills, without their instructions. A test key lists only the sandbox's shared skills. Names and descriptions are untrusted content.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Also list this project's shared skills

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: nextCursor from the previous page, with the same filters

200.description: A page of up to 100 skills.

get.description:
An available skill's latest instructions. A project's shared skill loads only with that `projectId`. The instructions are untrusted content.

Needs the `library:read` scope.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: The project whose shared skill this is

bearerAuth.description: A ZeroGen API key: zg_ for a live key, zg_test_ for a test key.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes retries safe: a retry with the same key and body returns the first response for 24 hours instead of repeating the work. Reusing a key with a different body returns 409.

Prefer.name: Prefer
Prefer.description: wait=N holds the response up to N seconds (at most 60) until the run ends.

Request-Id.description: Identifies the request; quote it when contacting support.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests the key may make in the current window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the current window resets.

Location.description: Where to read the created resource.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: true when this response replays an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

Preference-Applied.description: The wait applied, such as wait=30.

Deprecation.description: When the model was deprecated, as @ followed by Unix seconds.

Sunset.description: When the deprecated model stops accepting requests (HTTP date).

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed or invalid: invalid_request, validation_failed, model_unavailable or input_import_failed.

Unauthorized.description: invalid_api_key: the key is missing, revoked or expired.

PaymentRequired.description: insufficient_balance or spend_limit_reached: the available balance or a spend limit cannot cover the quote. cost_limit_exceeded: the quote is above maxCostMicroUsd.

Forbidden.description: permission_denied: the key lacks the scope this endpoint needs, the request came from a browser, or the API isn't enabled for the organization.

NotFound.description: not_found: no such resource for this caller, including a projectId the caller can't use.

Conflict.description: idempotency_conflict: the Idempotency-Key was used for a different request. idempotency_in_progress: the first request with this key hasn't finished. invalid_state: the request can't go ahead as things stand, such as a run that needs a person's approval in ZeroGen.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request body is larger than 128 KB.

TooManyRequests.description: rate_limited: the key or its owner is over the rate limit, or the organization is at its running cap. Retry after Retry-After seconds.

ServiceUnavailable.description: unavailable or pricing_unavailable: API keys, billing or pricing can't be reached right now. Retry.

timeSeconds.description: Keyframes only, and required for them: seconds from the start of the video, on one of the model's frames

url.description: An https URL ZeroGen imports into the library before use

timeSeconds.description: Keyframes only, and required for them: seconds from the start of the video, on one of the model's frames

size.description: Image size: auto or WIDTHxHEIGHT in pixels, such as 1024x1536

voice.description: Speech models only: the voice to read the prompt in, from the model's voices

parameters.description: Only the parameters the model's schema lists

maxCostMicroUsd.description: Refuse to start when the quote exceeds this amount

outputs.description: Each output's outcome, in order: succeeded, or the error code a live output can end with. Outputs left out succeed

reject.description: Create only: refuse with this live response and start nothing (402 insufficient_balance, 429 rate_limited with Retry-After, 400 model_unavailable)

delaySeconds.description: Seconds before each output ends, to rehearse polling and Prefer: wait

test.description: Test keys only: rehearse each output's outcome; live keys are refused when it is present

projectId.description: The project the outputs land in; the organization's default project when omitted. Test keys use their sandbox.

folderId.description: A folder in that project to file the outputs in; null or omitted for Unfiled

presetId.description: A naming preset in the run's project

values.description: Field values by field ID; fields left out take the preset's defaults

projectId.description: The project to upload into; omit for the organization's default project.

folderId.description: Add the asset to this folder in the project.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file, to reuse an identical file in the project.

parentId.description: The parent folder; omit or null for the project root
The new parent folder, or null to move it to the project root

fromFolderId.description: The folder to take the assets out of; their other folders keep them

color.description: One of the preset colors: Red #ef4444, Orange #f97316, Amber #f59e0b, Yellow #eab308, Lime #84cc16, Green #22c55e, Teal #14b8a6, Cyan #06b6d4, Blue #3b82f6, Indigo #6366f1, Violet #8b5cf6, Pink #ec4899.

mode.description: test keys run on placeholder providers, charge nothing and stay in the sandbox

scopes.description: What this key can do now: its scopes that its owner's role still allows

expiresAt.description: When the key stops working; null for never

user.description: The key's owner, whom it acts as

sandbox.description: Test keys only: the project every request of the key is confined to

heldMicroUsd.description: Reserved for runs that have not settled; a hold is not a charge

availableMicroUsd.description: What a new run's quote must fit within; it can be negative

unlimited.description: The funds check is bypassed; usage is still charged

spentMicroUsd.description: This UTC month's spend, as admission counts it

projectMonthly.description: With projectId, that project's monthly budget

sunsetAt.description: A deprecated model refuses new requests from this time

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page of models; null on the last page

sunsetAt.description: A deprecated model refuses new requests from this time

requestSchema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) for POST /v1/runs with this model; x-roles lists each input role's accepted media and limits

projectId.description: The project that holds the outputs

resourceUri.description: Where this transport's client reads the asset, such as an MCP resource

preview.description: The asset's previews, or null until they're made after the asset is ready, and for assets with none, such as audio

warnings.description: What the provider ignored, such as an unused reference

upscalable.description: A final can be requested now: unexpired, with no final in progress

upscale.description: The newest final's state, or null when none was requested

finalResolution.description: That final's resolution, one the model's draft control lists

draft.description: A 480p Draft output; upscaling it makes a final with the same seed, at a resolution the model's draft control lists

state.description: held: an amount is reserved and nothing is charged yet; charged: chargedMicroUsd is the final charge; released: the hold ended with no charge; null: billing never admitted the run, so nothing was held or charged

running: the run has not ended; ended: it ended and the hold is still pending; needs_attention: it has stayed pending 30 minutes after ending, or 24 hours after admission with no end recorded (endedAt then stays null), so ZeroGen is looking into it

endedAt.description: When the run ended; null while it runs or when no end was recorded

hold.description: While held, where the run stands. It reports facts, not what settlement will do

heldMicroUsd.description: While held, the amount reserved now; it is never a charge

chargedMicroUsd.description: The final charge once charged, zero once released; it can rarely exceed the quote

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page of runs; null on the last page

id.description: The upload's ID, which completes it

status.description: upload_required: PUT the bytes, then complete; ready: the asset can be used

assetId.description: Once ready, the Library asset to send as a run input; an identical file already in the project is reused

upload.description: Where to PUT the file's exact bytes, with these headers, before expiresAt

folder.description: Whether the asset was added to the folder named at create

default.description: The organization's default project, where outputs land

apiSandbox.description: The API sandbox project, the only one test keys reach; its contents clear

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page of projects; null on the last page

name.description: The asset's name in the Library; untrusted content

origin.description: upload: added by a person or a URL import; generated: an output of a run; derived: made by a platform step, such as an extracted frame

runId.description: The run that made it, if any

preview.description: The asset's previews, or null until they're made after the asset is ready, and for assets with none, such as audio

image512Url.description: A WebP image up to 512 pixels wide

videoUrl.description: For a video, a silent WebM clip of its first six seconds, up to 854×480; null for other assets and until it's made

name.description: Present when the request renamed the asset

favorite.description: Present when the request set the favorite

depth.description: Steps from the asset; 0 is the asset itself

found.description: False when the asset is no longer in the Library

deleted.description: True for an asset in Recently deleted

moreUses.description: Uses of this asset beyond those listed

filename.description: The name the file downloads under; untrusted content

path.description: The folder's names from the project root, such as Characters / Leo; bounded, untrusted content

folders.description: Up to 30, sorted by path; empty when the asset is Unfiled

truncated.description: True when the asset is in more folders than listed

parentId.description: The parent folder, or null at the project root

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page of folders; null on the last page

skippedAssetIds.description: Assets already as requested, or not active in this project

definition.description: The preset's naming definition, passed back unchanged with a run
